name: medallion
title: Medallion (Bronze / Silver / Gold)
description: Architecture blueprint for layered batch analytics on a Fabric Lakehouse: refine data progressively through Bronze (raw), Silver (cleansed), and Gold (business-ready) layers, then serve BI. Best for batch ETL that needs quality gates and reproducibility.
best_for: Batch data that must be progressively cleansed and modeled before analytics; teams that want reproducible, layered transformations.
primary_storage: Lakehouse (Delta) — one lakehouse per layer, or one lakehouse with Bronze/Silver/Gold schemas
key_ingestion: Data Pipeline or Copy Job (batch) into Bronze; Notebooks transform Bronze -> Silver -> Gold

item_set.purpose: Delta storage for each medallion layer
Shared Spark libraries/config for the notebooks (optional)
Land raw source data into Bronze
Orchestrate ingestion + the transform notebooks in order
Bronze->Silver->Gold PySpark transforms with quality gates
Direct Lake model over the Gold layer
Power BI report over the semantic model

decisions.guidance: Lakehouse Gold keeps everything in Delta and enables Direct Lake. Choose Warehouse Gold when consumers need read-write T-SQL, multi-table transactions, or strict SQL semantics.
Notebooks for interactive/scheduled PySpark. Spark Job Definitions for packaged, parameterized batch jobs promoted through CI/CD.
Copy Job for straight source->Bronze copies. Data Pipeline when you also need to orchestrate the transform notebooks. Dataflow Gen2 for low-code Power Query prep.

build_with.deploy_ordering: fabio deploy plan/apply already orders items correctly (Lakehouse -> Environment -> Notebook -> SemanticModel -> Report -> DataPipeline). No manual sequencing needed.
outline: Create the lakehouse(s) (one per layer, or --enable-schemas for Bronze/Silver/Gold schemas).
Land raw data into Bronze via copy-job or data-pipeline.
Author + run Bronze->Silver->Gold notebooks (fabio notebook create --file ... --lakehouse; notebook run --wait).
Build a Direct Lake semantic model over Gold (see workflow direct-lake-report).
Create a report; schedule the pipeline for recurring refresh.
